home.title: Meki Batu Union | Ethiopian Fruit & Vegetable Cooperative
home.description: Empowering smallholder farmers across the Ethiopian Rift Valley to produce and export high-quality fruits, vegetables, and certified seeds.

about.title: Cooperative Heritage & Governance | Meki Batu Union
about.description: Established in 2002, Meki Batu Union represents smallholder farmer cooperatives committed to democratic governance, quality certifications, and agricultural leadership.

products.title: Horticultural Produce & Certified Seeds | Meki Batu Union
products.description: Browse fresh Ethiopian harvests including export-grade red onions, greenhouse tomatoes, hot peppers, Cavendish bananas, papaya, and inspected hybrid seeds.

farmers.title: Smallholder Services & Cooperative Membership | Meki Batu Union
farmers.description: Explore union membership services including tractor mechanization, subsidized seed distribution, agronomic field training, and fair pricing mechanisms.

buyers.title: Commercial Produce Sourcing & Export Logistics | Meki Batu Union
buyers.description: Source GlobalG.A.P certified Rift Valley vegetables and fruits with batch traceability, cold-chain handling, and dependable seasonal supply for global markets.

retailOutlets.title: Farm-Direct Retail Storefronts in Addis Ababa | Meki Batu Union
retailOutlets.description: Find locations and opening hours for our 5 official union retail shops across Addis Ababa delivering fresh produce directly from farm to table.

news.title: Harvest Reports, Trade Updates & Press Releases | Meki Batu Union
news.description: Stay informed with the latest cooperative assembly reports, seasonal harvest projections, cold storage milestones, and agricultural trade updates.

impact.title: Social Impact, Sustainability & Community Growth | Meki Batu Union
impact.description: Discover how our programs advance women farmer leadership, sustainable drip irrigation, school construction, and rural prosperity in the Rift Valley.

contact.title: Contact Cooperative Headquarters & Sales | Meki Batu Union
contact.description: Reach our central office in Meki Town or distribution representatives in Addis Ababa for trade inquiries, membership information, and customer support.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection | Meki Batu Union
privacyPolicy.description: Learn how Meki Batu Union collects, uses, and safeguards personal information submitted through our website and inquiry forms.

termsOfService.description: Review the terms and conditions governing the use of the Meki Batu Union website, catalog content, and downloadable resources.
